title: Re: Abadumdadumdummmddon
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abadumdadumdummmddon and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 7A: Neck Rolls, Gullets, and Jowls and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Abadumdadumdummmddon and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 7A: Neck Rolls, Gullets, and Jowls and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

There are times I really wish that some monsters would just stop respawning...but then again there is quite a bit of fun to be had destroying the same ugly mug over and over again! Don't you feel the same? I mean, a monster like Abadumdadumdummmddon is just begging to be farmed. Think about it this way: why would Abadumdadumdummmddon keep coming back if he didn't, on some level, enjoy getting slain?

Don't keep Abadumdadumdummmddon waiting too long. If he goes a couple minutes without being killed he gets irritable and we don't want that. When you have taken Abadumdadumdummmddon down, as well as some of those eerie little Abba Labbas, return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

You never cease to amaze me, Dungeon Runner. Do you want to try this quest again?

Objectives:

  • Kill Abadumdadumdummmddon
  • Kill Abba Labbas

Client level range: 44–46
